note: Condenser-side flow temperature of the heat pump itself (before buffer/DHW valve). Equals fg=60/fn=254 dp 17 within 0.2 K over a full DHW run. Hoval's Modbus list carries this as 31892/31893, but the name column of that whole block (31892-31921) is shifted by rows in the public list -- trust the CAN dp, not the register name.
Return temperature at the heat pump. Equals fg=60/fn=254 dp 29 within 0.1 K. Modbus 31894/31895 (same name-shift caveat as dp 257).

Speed of the heat pump's internal circulation pump (Modbus 27495/27496 "CP rotation speed" -- that name is correct). Observed: 80 % on compressor start, then tracks modulation (roughly 0.73 x modulation % during a DHW run: 50->40->32->25->13 %), 30 % in standby/after-run with compressor off. **0xFFFFFFFF = pump off**, not a reading -- filter it, otherwise consumers show -1 or 4294967295.

Water volume flow through the heat pump (Modbus 31707/31708, name correct). 33.7 L/min at 80 % pump, 28.9 at 50 %, 26.1 at 40 %, 21.9 at 25 %, 16.1 at 30 % standby, 0 with pump off. Physics check: Q x (dp257 - dp258) x 4.18 / 60 reproduces the controller's own thermal power (12.7/14.4 kW computed vs 13/14 kW reported) -- i.e. this flow and the two temperatures are exactly what the heat-quantity counters are built from.

UNVERIFIED / SILENT: dp 259/260/262/263/264 (intake air, suction gas, hot gas, low/high pressure, compressor speed per Hoval's list, Modbus 31896-31907) never answer a GET on an UltraSource B comfort C17 -- neither idle nor with the compressor running; the Modbus registers stay 0. Refrigerant-circuit values are apparently not exposed on this model over CAN. dp 261/273/275/276/1570 (groundwater / buffer probes) read 0x80000000 = sensor not fitted on an air-source unit.
